captions.detailed: A compact set of theatre binoculars designed in a matte black finish. It features two slim, cylindrical objective barrel housings containing optical lenses, connected by a central bridge hinge. At the center of the bridge is a textured focusing wheel on a revolute joint, while each eyepiece is fitted with a twist-up eyecup sleeve that rotates independently.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a compact 8x21 theatre binocular with adjustable barrels. The assembly should include two optical barrel housings connected to a central bridge via a revolute hinge, a central focus knob, and twist-up eyecups on each eyepiece, all rendered in a clean matte black material.
captions.factory: Construct the central bridge using a base cylinder and box primitives for the structural hinge. Build the left and right objective barrels by lofting and unioning multiple concentric cylinders of varying radii to form the tapered housings. Create the central focusing wheel and the twist-up eyecups as separate cylindrical parts, and then define revolute joint connections between the barrels and the bridge, as well as for the focusing wheel and eyecups.
